description: Make the cover-led share card for a moment, a square one and a tall one, into the artist's Library: the release's cover, the artist's name and the moment's words, on the cover's own colors. Made from the artist's cover and name, no AI. Free. Made once per moment and kept: asking again gives the same cards. The moments: out_now: a release that is out, "Out now" over its cover (release_id). still_on_repeat: a release out for a while, "Still on repeat" and the day it came out (release_id). meet: "Meet the artist" with the artist's genre and hometown, on the cover of release_id, else of their newest release. show: a show from list_events, its city, day and venue (event_id), on the cover of the release the show is for, else release_id. milestone: the artist's newest Good news (a listener count passed, a playlist add), or the newest about release_id. Put a card on a picture post with add_post or update_post (media_asset_id).

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

moment.description: Which moment the card is for.

release_id.description: The release (list_releases): required for out_now and still_on_repeat; for the others, whose cover leads the card.

name: make_card
title: Make a share card
